free_tier.stated: New accounts get free credit to try the API, and a first top-up within 7 days of signing up adds up to $100 in credit on top: $10 gets $2, $50 gets $15, $250 gets $100. The landing page advertises 'Get up to $100 in free credits' and the startup program offers up to $5,000 in credits to accepted early-stage startups.
free_tier.notes: The size of the signup credit before a top-up is not stated on the pricing or sandbox page, so it is unverified; the advertised $100 requires a paid top-up within 7 days and the startup program requires an application. Add credit from $5; credits never expire.

per_object_cap.stated: 25 GB of disk is included per sandbox; no per-object cap is stated
per_object_cap.notes: The sandbox is a filesystem rather than an object store; the 25 GB figure is a disk allowance, not a single-object cap.

retention.stated: A sandbox lives until the user deletes it, with no session time limit; paused sandboxes sleep after 5 idle minutes and are kept free with memory and files intact. For the model API, Chat and Messages requests are never stored, Responses API responses are kept 30 days unless zero data retention is switched on, and only 30 days of metadata is kept for billing.
retention.notes: Sandbox lifetime is unbounded by policy; only the model API retention windows are stated as numbers.

egress.terms: unverified: the pricing page and sandbox page publish no egress price, transfer allowance or traffic quota; the sandbox offers a preview URL per port and outbound commands, but no per-GB rate is stated

interface_detail: One API key works for models and sandboxes. The OpenAI-compatible endpoint is https://api.openscale.so/v1 and the Anthropic endpoint is https://api.openscale.so/anthropic; E2B-compatible SDKs switch with E2B_DOMAIN=sandbox.openscale.so and E2B_API_KEY. Commands, streaming, an interactive terminal, files, preview URLs, a headless browser, pause and resume are included.
tooling: npm i -g openscale-cli for the openscale/osc CLI, or set E2B_DOMAIN and E2B_API_KEY and use an existing E2B JS or Python SDK. The user installs and runs the SDK or CLI against the hosted sandbox fleet.
chaining: Hosted Firecracker sandboxes share one key and balance with hosted model inference, so an agent can run code and call models from one account; E2B compatibility lets existing agent code switch with two environment variables.

limits.value: 100 requests a minute and 10,000,000 tokens a minute per account, shared across its API keys
100 sandboxes at once by default, more on request; 25 GB disk included per sandbox; 1-8 vCPU and up to 16 GB memory
a sandbox auto-pauses after 5 idle minutes with auto-pause on; paused sandboxes cost nothing and a busy sandbox never sleeps mid-task
an API key is required; a missing or revoked key returns 401, and an account must be created before a key can be made

limits_note: A plan key waits for a free agent slot when all of the plan's agents are busy unless X-Wait-For-Slot: false is sent, in which case the call returns 429 plan_slots_busy. Volumes, secrets, fork and the snapshots API are not supported yet, and no GPU is offered in the sandbox shape.
binding_note: The 100-requests-a-minute per-account ceiling binds an agent loop before the 100-concurrent-sandbox default, and the rate budget is shared across every key on the account.

identity_cost.detail: An account is created at app.openscale.so/signup to get an API key, and a card is needed for the first top-up that unlocks the advertised credit match; add credit from $5 and card top-ups carry a processing fee, so $10 in credits costs $11.05 by card. The exact signup form fields were not opened, so the email and password requirements beyond the account creation step are unverified.

reliability_note: A request that crosses its per-minute budget returns 429 with Retry-After; plan keys wait for a free agent slot or can fail fast with plan_slots_busy. Sandboxes run in Singapore only for now, and volumes, secrets, fork and the snapshots API are not supported.
confidence_note: The sandbox rate, included resources, billing model, retention, rate limits and credit terms are quoted from openscale.so's own pricing, sandbox and docs pages read 2026-11-24. The signup credit amount and egress terms are not published and are unverified.

Create a key in the dashboard ([sign up](https://app.openscale.so/signup?utm_source=api_reference&utm_medium=docs) if you have no account yet) and send it on every request:


Keys are shown once when created. A missing or revoked key returns `401`.
